documents.title: Code Quality Standards
documents.content:
All code must follow these quality standards:
1. Minimum 80% test coverage
2. All functions must have JSDoc comments
3. No console.log statements in production code
4. Maximum cyclomatic complexity of 10
documents.author: Engineering Team

documents.title: Security Compliance Rules
documents.content:
Security requirements for all merge requests:
1. No hardcoded credentials
2. All dependencies must be scanned for vulnerabilities
3. Input validation required for all user inputs
4. SQL injection prevention mandatory
documents.author: Security Team
